theory.intro: The **critical path** is the longest path through a network from Start to Finish. Its length is the **minimum completion time**, the shortest time the whole project can take. Every activity on it has zero float.
facts: The length of a path is the sum of the durations of the activities along it.
A **critical activity** has a float time of $0$, so delaying it delays the whole project.
The critical path is the chain of critical activities running from the Start vertex to the Finish vertex.
The minimum completion time is the length of the longest path, never the shortest path and never the sum of every duration.
A network has two critical paths when two different paths share the same greatest length.
steps: List every path from Start to Finish
Add the activity durations along each path
Identify the longest path as the critical path
State its length as the minimum completion time
